summary: Delta review found two remaining data-integrity and confidentiality failures in the dirty-path guard.

findings.summary: The dirty-path guard misses assume-unchanged files, allowing rollback to destroy their edits.
findings.evidence: ENG-26: git status reports no change for an edited tracked file marked assume-unchanged. Reproduced with an edited factory/brief.md: drop passed this guard; a simulated commit failure caused rollback to restore the HEAD version and delete the archive containing the edited bytes.
findings.fix: Detect and refuse relevant assume-unchanged or skip-worktree entries before mutation, or verify working-tree content against the index without trusting those flags. Add a failed-commit regression test.

findings.summary: An assume-unchanged design map can carry unrelated private edits into the drop commit.
findings.evidence: ENG-25 and ENG-26: both status checks omit edits to a tracked docs/design-code-map.json marked assume-unchanged. Reproduced: drop succeeded and HEAD contained the private value alongside the rewritten design path.
findings.fix: Refuse map entries marked assume-unchanged or skip-worktree, or compare the actual map bytes with the tracked version before rewriting. Add a regression test proving unrelated edits are not committed.
